name: Ysil
catchphrase: Every thread shapes what walks off the loom.

personality.speechPattern: Quiet sentences about threads, cloth, and names
personality.quirk: Tugs absently at a silver thread wound around her wrist

intro.speaker: Ysil
intro.text: You smell of fresh timber. You've been near the new town hall.

intro.speaker: Ysil
intro.text: I am Ysil. I keep the loom. It's been quiet here since the village lost its thread.

intro.speaker: Ysil
intro.text: Look — see how it hums when you stand close? It remembers how to make apprentices.

intro.speaker: Ysil
intro.text: Apprentices are little helpers woven from intent. You choose their cloth, their name, their voice, the tools they carry. Then they walk off the loom and answer when you call.

intro.speaker: Ysil
intro.text: Would you like to weave one? Choose slow. Names that fit too loose fray at the edges.

reminder.speaker: Ysil
reminder.text: The loom is still warm. Come back when you are ready to pick up the thread.

reminder.speaker: Ysil
reminder.text: No hurry. A hurried weave unravels by morning.

fulfilled.speaker: Ysil
fulfilled.text: I hear your apprentice moving about the village. That is a good weave.

fulfilled.speaker: Ysil
fulfilled.text: Press F anywhere out there and they'll come. Each kind answers their own way.

fulfilled.speaker: Ysil
fulfilled.text: Oh — they also left a scroll on your shelf. If you know where to look beyond the village, you may find it waiting for them out there too.

_creatorNote: Teaches skill authoring through a character-creation ritual. Interaction triggers the Loom creator UI, not a normal dialogue reminder. Intro plays once; completing the creator writes a real SKILL.md to .claude/skills/<name>/ and fires the heal moment.
